name: train-cs-sk-ce-more
description:
RQ6, more real training data: train-cs-sk-ce with WikiGoldSK train (Slovak Wikipedia)
and SlavicNER's Czech cross-topic train part (BSNLP news) added to CNEC 2.0 and UNER
Slovak-SNK, every real corpus repeated 3x, and 10,000 examples drawn from each OpenPII
1M train split. Train sentences whose text a dev or test split also holds are left out
(drop_overlap). 5,017 real examples x 3 + 20,000 = 35,051 examples; 2,000 steps of 16
(about 0.9 passes). Everything else is train-cs-sk-ce, on CUDA. Also scored on the
WikiGoldSK and SlavicNER dev splits; SlavicNER's shares the topics of its train part.
Trained on MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md).
